description: This file defines the WeeklyReportGenerator class, responsible for generating and queuing weekly project reports via email. It interacts with repositories for projects, users, and tasks, and utilizes an email service to send templated emails.

classes.name: WeeklyReportGenerator
classes.description: A service class that generates weekly reports for projects by sending email summaries to project users.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the WeeklyReportGenerator with dependencies: project, user, task repositories, email service, and logger.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates weekly project reports by querying projects, retrieving associated users and tasks, and sending email summaries.
